description: This file defines the OAuthAccessToken entity class mapped to the database table 'ohrm_oauth2_access_token'. It models OAuth2 access token data including token string, client and user IDs, expiry time, and revoked status, with getters and setters for each property.

classes.name: OAuthAccessToken
classes.description: Represents an OAuth2 access token entity with properties for token details, expiry, and status, with accessor methods.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the access token.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the access token.

methods.name: getClientId
methods.description: Returns the client ID associated with this token.

methods.name: getUserId
methods.description: Returns the user ID associated with the token.

methods.name: getExpiryDateTime
methods.description: Returns the expiry date and time in UTC timezone.

methods.name: setExpiryDateTime
methods.description: Sets the expiry date and time.

methods.name: isRevoked
methods.description: Indicates whether the token has been revoked.
